shapeSummary: 72 mm diameter, 16 mm thick idler wheel disc with its axis along Z and its bottom at Y=0 (center at Y=36). One face has an annular recess (r 18–33 mm, 8 mm deep) that leaves a raised outer rim and a central hub. It has an 8 mm central through bore and eight 4 mm through holes on a 56 mm bolt circle.
warnings: All dimensions are estimates; the source gives none.
The 8 mm bore is assumed; the real part likely has a larger bearing seat.
The bolt-hole count and positions are uncertain.
Recess depth and radii are approximate.
Lightening slots, bolt bosses, ribs, hex pockets, the bearing and the screw are not modeled.
The opposite face is assumed flat, although the real part may have a matching recess.
cadquery:
r=36
t=16
body=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(r).extrude(t/2,both=True)
# recessed web on +Z face, leaving outer rim and central hub
pocket=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=t/2).circle(33).circle(18).extrude(-8)
body=body.cut(pocket)
# central bore
body=body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-t/2).circle(4).extrude(t))
# ring of 8 bolt holes on 56 mm bolt circle
pts=[(28*math.cos(math.radians(a*45)),28*math.sin(math.radians(a*45))) for a in range(8)]
holes=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-t/2).pushPoints(pts).circle(2).extrude(t)
body=body.cut(holes)
part=body.translate((0,r,0))
